notes: POST /v1/heartbeats protocol with ID rotation. Bootstrap: send an EMPTY heartbeat_id; the response returns a new ID. Each successful response returns a new ID to use for the following heartbeat. Cadence: every 5 seconds; if a valid heartbeat is not received within 10 seconds all open orders owned by those CLOB API credentials are canceled; the cancellation check runs every 5 seconds. On 400 Invalid Heartbeat ID the response supplies the expected ID and the client must send a fresh request using it. Heartbeat ids are synthetic placeholders.
